dispatches.message: MISINFORMATION ALERT Helldivers are to be aware of recent falsified reports fraudulently claiming that Termicide 2.0 exposure has increased the spread of the Gloom. The Ministry of Truth is investigating the source of this blatant attempt to deceive our citizens with outlandish lies. In the meantime, all personnel are ordered to report any credulous discussion of these rumors.
STRATEGIC UPDATE Orbital Laser Stratagem availability has now ended.

MAJOR ORDER FAILED The naked hatred of our enemies has made the construction of the Malevelon Creek Interrogation Center for Human Rights impossible. Funding issues have unfortunately forced the Records Department to erase the bottom 10% of fallen heroes from their records, affecting all soldiers with last names beginning with Y and Z.

MINOR TERMINID OUTBREAK A minor Terminid outbreak has occurred on FORI PRIME, likely merely the result of recent system updates to the TCS+ firmware. While the outbreak is minor and will be contained in due time, Helldivers are welcome to aid in the containment, should they so choose, but the threat is assessed as very low and barely worth attention.
STRATAGEM GRANTED The Orbital Laser Stratagem has been authorized for immediate use on Choepessa IV, for the next 24 hours.

SYSTEMS NOTIFICATION Some Galactic Map users may have observed the apparent presence of enemy forces occupying dozens of planets. This issue was due to an unconcerning software glitch that has since been rectified. This experience may have given rise to some uncomfortable feelings, such as concern, terror, or abject despair. Distressed users are advised to visualize relaxing images, such as: -a fluttering Super Earth flag -a filled-out ballot -the inevitable destruction of Freedom's enemies

NEW MAJOR ORDER Enemy aggression has made the construction of the Malevelon Creek Memorial & Interrogation Center for Human Rights impossible. The project has therefore been downscoped to solely consist of the Interrogation Center for Human Rights. To aid development of more effective digital interrogation techniques, the Helldivers are ordered to acquire 35,000,000 Automaton samples and kill 60,000,000 Cyborgs.
SCAVENGER RAMPAGE UPDATE Scavenger numbers on Terminid warfront have returned to normal levels.
ARSENAL AUGMENTATION ENDED Free availability of the Anti-Materiel Rifle Stratagem for forces on the Illuminate front has now ended.
ARSENAL AUGMENTATION ENDED Free availability of the Orbital Railcannon Strike Stratagem for forces on the Automaton front has now ended.
ARSENAL AUGMENTATION ENDED Free availability of the HMG Emplacement Stratagem for forces on the Terminid front has now ended.

MAJOR ORDER FAILED The efforts of the Helldivers to support the inspiration and education of our citizens was heartlessly stolen by our enemies. Limited footage of Helldivers defending Freedom was gathered; the decision was made by the studio to instead construct the footage digitally. The ballooning budget means that proceeds can no longer support the construction of the Malevelon Creek Memorial & Interrogation Center for Human Rights.
ARSENAL AUGMENTATION ENDED Free availability of the Shield Generator Pack Stratagem for forces on the Illuminate front has now ended.
ARSENAL AUGMENTATION ENDED Free availability of the Gas Mines Stratagem for forces on the Terminid front has now ended.

STRATEGIC OPPORTUNITY SEIZED Helldivers have contained the outbreak on Nivel 43, securing essential footage for Democratic Sniper. Simultaneously, reports of new Terminid mutations have been investigated; the mutations were determined to be merely superficial changes, well within normal Terminid gene expression. The Ministry of Truth has deemed the filmed footage to be of masterfully evocative cinematic quality. As a result, the remaining major order requirements are reduced by 50%.

NEW STRATEGIC OPPORTUNITY A Terminid outbreak has occurred on Nivel 43, likely due to the splintered remnants of the eco-fascistic terrorist network culled in the Counterdissident Hammer campaign. While the threat is assessed as very low, it presents an opportunity to capture vital footage of their wanton aggression. Helldivers must aid in this virtuously expedient cause and liberate Nivel 43. Securing the footage will reduce remaining major order requirement by 50%.
SCAVENGER RAMPAGE Significantly higher Scavenger numbers have been observed on the Terminid warfront.
ARSENAL AUGMENTATION To bolster war efforts, the Shield Generator Relay Stratagem has been made freely available for all Helldiver deployments on the Illuminate warfront, for the next 48 hours.
ARSENAL AUGMENTATION To bolster war efforts, the Gas Mines Stratagem has been made freely available for all Helldiver deployments on the Terminid warfront, for the next 48 hours.

ARSENAL BOOST High Command has authorized high-volume use of the Orbital Railcannon Stratagem on the Automaton warfront. For operations on that warfront, the mandated waiting period between salvos has been lowered by 120 seconds for the next 72 hours.
ARSENAL AUGMENTATION To bolster war efforts, the Anti-Materiel Rifle Stratagem has been made freely available for all Helldiver deployments on the Illuminate warfront, for the next 120 hours.
ARSENAL AUGMENTATION To bolster war efforts, the Orbital Railcannon Strike Stratagem has been made freely available for all Helldiver deployments on the Automaton warfront, for the next 120 hours.
ARSENAL AUGMENTATION To bolster war efforts, the HMG Emplacement Stratagem has been made freely available for all Helldiver deployments on the Terminid warfront, for the next 120 hours.

NEW MAJOR ORDER The Ministry of Truth is producing an inspirational education film called "Democratic Sniper." Proceeds from the film will go towards construction of the Malevelon Creek Memorial & Interrogation Center for Human Rights. Much of the film will consist of real battlefield footage. The Helldivers are ordered to kill 300,000,000 Terminids, 65,000,000 Illuminates, and 50,000,000 Automatons in order to ensure the availability of sufficiently high-quality footage.

MAJOR ORDER LOST Enemy aggression has denied the rightful return of certain territories to Freedom's embrace. The Malevelon Creek Memorial & Interrogation Center for Human Rights project is on rocky ground—a consequence that Democracy's enemies doubtlessly celebrate with glee. So long as our resources remain in enemy hands, our fallen heroes will suffer grave insult.

NEW MAJOR ORDER To honor the fallen, the government has authorized the construction of The Malevelon Creek Memorial & Interrogation Center for Human Rights. However, enemy aggression threatens this project. Their occupation of Super Earth territories rich in rare metals, crude oil, and radioactive isotopes, among others, steals from the prosperity of all. This is an insult to the memory of our heroes. The Helldivers are ordered to liberate FURY, ESKER, and ZEA RUGOSIA.
STRATEGIC ALERT The Automaton Incineration Corps has been reported on VINDEMITARIX PRIME.

MAJOR ORDER WON Thanks to the Helldivers’ philanthropic bravery and altruistic lethality, the AIR (Anti-Illuminate Restitution) initiative has been funded to its maximum level. Every revered Class A orbital retirement facility affected by recent Illuminate interference has now received a heavily subsidised upgrade to their respiratory fortification package. With regional real estate futures fully stabilized and all corporate liabilities mitigated, the Helldivers stand triumphant.

CONTROL CENTER ADVISORY Upon completion of this Campaign, Helldivers will receive permanent access to the DSS Eagle Gas Storm Tactical Action. The technician responsible for mislabeling this performance incentive as a Stratagem in the Control Center has committed to thoroughly understanding the distinction between a Tactical Action and a Stratagem during an intensive re-education seminar, alongside their immediate family.

MAJOR ORDER ADJUSTMENT Ongoing analysis of current major order has identified a reprioritization of objectives. Helldivers are called to immediately assist SEAF in the defense of Senge-23 by culling huge swaths of illuminates. The target for mission operations is deprioritized.

tacticalActions.name: EAGLE STORM
tacticalActions.strategicDescription: Deploys periodic Eagle Gas Strikes during missions. Slows enemy progress in Defense Campaigns.

tacticalActions.name: ORBITAL BLOCKADE
tacticalActions.strategicDescription: Defense Campaigns cannot originate from this planet. The Hellpod Space Optimization Booster is automatically active for all missions.

tacticalActions.name: HEAVY ORDNANCE DISTRIBUTION
tacticalActions.strategicDescription: Gives access to the Orbital 380mm HE Barrage stratagem during missions. Accelerates progress in Liberation Campaigns.

active_campaign.title: MEMORIAM ETERNAL
active_campaign.label: ACTIVE CAMPAIGN
active_campaign.description: With the approach of Liberty Day, the Super Earth Government has authorized the construction of the Malevelon Creek Memorial & Interrogation Center for Human Rights. The Helldivers are needed to bravely acquire the material resources needed to honor the fallen heroes of the Second Galactic War.
active_campaign.description_cn: 解放日即将到来，超级地球政府已批准建造麦拉芬蒙河纪念碑与人权审讯中心。我们需要绝地潜兵英勇地获取所需的物资，以此向在第二次星系战争中牺牲的英雄们致敬。

phases.title: HONOR THE FALLEN
phases.briefing:
Liberty Day approaches, and with it, the responsibility to honor the memories of fallen heroes. The Super Earth Government has passed a bill authorizing the construction of a memorial worthy of their sacrifices: the Malevelon Creek Memorial & Interrogation Center for Human Rights.

As the name implies, the Memorial would honor the fallen not just in thought, but in action: through enhanced interrogation of dissidents and enemies of Freedom.

However, wanton aggression from all 3 enemy factions threatens this project. Their occupation of Super Earth territories rich in rare metals, crude oil, and radioactive isotopes, among others, steals from the prosperity of all. This is an insult to the memory of our heroes. The Helldivers are ordered to liberate FURY, ESKER, and ZEA RUGOSIA.
phases.briefing_cn:
解放日即将来临，随之而来的是缅怀牺牲英雄的责任。超级地球政府已通过一项法案，批准建造一项纪念设施：麦拉芬蒙河纪念碑与人权审讯中心，以此纪念他们的牺牲。

正如其名，这座纪念设施不仅要在思想上纪念陨落的英雄，更要付诸行动：即对异见分子和自由之敌进行高级审讯。

然而，来自全部3个敌方阵营的肆意侵略正在威胁着该项目。他们占领了超级地球的领土，那里富含稀有金属、原油和放射性同位素等资源，无异于窃取全人类的繁荣。简直是对我们逝去英雄的侮辱。绝地潜兵奉命解放费里、艾斯克尔和泽亚鲁戈西亚。

phases.title: INSPIRATIONAL RE-ENACTMENT
phases.briefing:
The Ministry of Truth is producing an inspirational education film called "Democratic Sniper." Proceeds from the film will go towards construction of the Malevelon Creek Memorial & Interrogation Center for Human Rights, and entitlement payouts for families of fallen soldiers.

The film is a dramatic re-enactment of the story of the deadliest Helldiver in the history of the Second Galactic War, with over 4,000 confirmed kills in the course of their 32 minutes of service. It stars Kurt Calhoun, voted 2186's most Democratic bachelor. 

Much of the film will consist of real battlefield footage. The Helldivers are ordered to kill 300,000,000 Terminids, 65,000,000 Illuminates, and 50,000,000 Automatons to ensure this story is told with the visual spectacle it deserves.
phases.briefing_cn:
真理部正在制作一部名为《民主狙击手》的励志教育片。该电影的收益将用于建造麦拉芬蒙河纪念碑与人权审讯中心，以及为阵亡士兵家属发放抚恤金。

本片以戏剧化的手法，重现了第二次星系战争史上最致命的绝地潜兵的故事，这名战士在32分钟的服役时间之内，可确认的击杀数超过4000。本片由库尔特·卡尔霍恩主演，他在2186年被评为最具民主风范的单身汉。

这部电影的大部分内容将来自战场实拍。绝地潜兵奉命击杀300,000,000个Terminids、65,000,000个Illuminates以及50,000,000个Automatons，确保该故事能呈现出符合预期的视觉奇观。

phases.title: INTERROGATION ENHANCEMENT
phases.briefing:
Enemy aggression has made the construction of the Malevelon Creek Memorial & Interrogation Center for Human Rights impossible.

The project has therefore been downscoped to solely consist of the Interrogation Center for Human Rights. As the Automatons were the belligerents who attacked Malevelon Creek, it is only fitting that one of the frontiers of research is digital interrogation: the extraction of information from mechanical and cybernetic combatants. Unpleasant Sensory Experience Simulations have been used to great effect since the start of the Galactic War. 

To aid development of more effective digital interrogation techniques, the Helldivers are ordered to acquire 35,000,000 Automaton samples and kill 60,000,000 Radicals.
phases.briefing_cn:
由于敌人的侵略，麦拉芬蒙河纪念碑与人权审讯中心已无法建造。

因此，该项目的规模已被缩小，仅建造人权审讯中心。鉴于机器人是袭击麦拉芬蒙河的交战方，我们将数字审讯定为研究的前沿领域：也就是从机械与改造士兵的体内提取信息。自从星系战争爆发以来，痛苦感知模拟已投入使用，而且取得了显著成效。

为了协助开发更有效的数字审讯技术，绝地潜兵奉命获取35,000,000份机器人样本，并击杀60,000,000个生化人。
